input.quote: The exclusive remedy of either party in a claim against the other under this Agreement shall be the recovery of its direct damages.
input.rationale: Section 15 is mutual as to the exclusion of indirect/consequential damages and carves out Sections 13 and 14, but it contains no aggregate monetary cap at all, so both parties (including us) are exposed without limit for direct damages, and the "exclusive remedy" wording could also cut across warranty remedies. We added a mutual cap at the greater of 12 months' fees and USD 1,000,000 with Excluded Claims (confidentiality, IP indemnity, gross negligence, wilful misconduct, fraud, IP infringement) outside the cap and payment obligations excluded from "damages".

input.quote: Garman agrees to indemnify Sparkling and hold it harmless from any and all losses, damages and expenses including without limitation, court costs, arbitration fees, penalties, fines, amounts paid in settlement of claims and reasonable legal fees and expenses of investigation (collectively the "Losses") which Sparkling or any of its respective officers or directors may incur due to a breach of this warranty.
input.rationale: A Garman IP indemnity exists (with procure/modify/replace remedies and, helpfully, outside the Section 15 limitation via the Section 13/14 carve-out), so the fallback is broadly met, but it is limited to breach of the IP ownership warranty and there is no indemnity for breach of law, data compromise or gross negligence/wilful misconduct; the ten-day notice condition is also unqualified. We added the missing heads and a material-prejudice qualifier to the notice requirement.

input.quote: (g) not use the Work to act as a service bureau in whole or in part, for any other Person, except for any affiliate of Sparkling operating at the Authorized Locations.
input.rationale: We reviewed the use restrictions (Section 3) and General Matters (Section 20) and found no covenant restricting the businesses Sparkling may operate or the products it may buy or build. The only restrictions are ordinary licence-scope limits (no service-bureau use, no reverse engineering), which do not restrain our business lines.

input.quote: a non-transferable and non-exclusive licence to use
input.rationale: No exclusivity, sole-source or requirements obligation binds Sparkling: the licence is expressly non-exclusive and neither the maintenance provisions (Section 10) nor the fees provision (Section 11) requires us to source support or related products only from Garman.
